definition.description: Change Radar: collect the active licensing guide change logs (crdr_feed kind pdf_changelog): when a guide PDF changes (Last-Modified), read it with AI Builder text recognition and keep one signal per change log row. The first run of a feed is silent (ADR 0019, spike T12).
